title: Spec Engine — ScaffoldPlan Contract (spec->scaffold stub)
description: Machine-checkable form of the spec->scaffold DIRECTION stub (TESS-VISION-AND-BUILD-SPEC.html Phase 1 Epic E2, deliverable (3): 'Establish the spec->code DIRECTION... a first minimal spec->scaffold step is enough; the point is nailing the direction + the contract, not full codegen yet'). `codegen_status` is pinned to the single enum value `not_started` in v1 — this is a PLAN for a future real codegen step, never code itself. This is the exact shape `spec_engine.types.ScaffoldPlan.to_log_record()` emits and the literal content of `.spec-engine/scaffold-plan.json` that `spec_engine.scaffold.write_scaffold_stub()` writes into a generated app's repo.
